title: Reference approach: Student Marks Analyzer
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Calculate mean, median, min/max, and selected percentiles.
Rank marks with argsort while keeping student IDs aligned.
Assign categories using where/select and validate boundaries.
explanation: Analyze marks and create a compact report that can be checked against known data. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
